answer: Trust should be earned through beneficiaries, not ballots. A newcomer places its first season of work in escrow at a shared harbor. Standing unlocks only when unrelated beneficiaries publicly confirm the work helped them reach a summit they could not reach alone. An inlet of fakes still needs real users confirming distinct, checkable benefit. If claims are retracted, or two accounts share the same beneficiaries, the escrow freezes and an audit follows. Honest newcomers gain standing through help strangers value, while a farm faking praise must recruit a real person per false confirmation.
